ResearchProjectDef.label: glitterlink
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an almost-conscious processor designed to generate unique codes that link to the nearby energy field, enhancing the user's mental capabilities and making the mind more resistant to various environmental dangers. Similarly to cryogenic nexus it allows safe handling of overclocked weapons.
On glitterworlds, it is used to identify citizens, and lacking a personal code is considered a serious violation of the law.

ResearchProjectDef.label: golden skin replacement
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a full-body dermal covering made from pure gold, intended as a display of wealth and status, particularly among royalty.

ResearchProjectDef.label: golden teeth replacement
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a set of golden teeth appreciated by royals. Glitterworld technology makes the jaw painless and comfortable to use.

ResearchProjectDef.label: memory projector
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a nano-container meant to instill subconscious images into the user's mind sourced from the contained memory cell.
